notes.title: The Devil's Face Update 1.6.4 - Unreal Engine Upgrade, DirectX 12 DM6 & More!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We’re thrilled to roll out Update 1.6.4 for The Devil’s Face! This update brings exciting enhancements to elevate your gaming experience.

What’s New?
[olist]
[*] Unreal Engine Upgrade
[*] DirectX 12 DM6 Shader Support
[*] DLC Slot Added
[/olist]

[h2]Unreal Engine Upgrade[/h2]

We’ve upgraded the game from Unreal Engine 5.1.1 to Unreal Engine 5.5.1, delivering better performance, stability, and visuals.

[h2]DirectX 12 DM6 Shader Support[/h2]

Added support for the DM6 Shader on DirectX 12, unlocking even more optimized graphics and smoother gameplay on supported systems.

[h2]DLC Slot Added[/h2]

A new slot has been added to the main menu for the The Devil’s Face Soundtrack DLC.
We can’t wait for you to experience these improvements! Update now and dive into the enhanced world of The Devil’s Face!

[b]Thank you for your continued support![/b]

— Tzavis Studio

notes.title: Immerse Yourself in Enhanced Terror: "The Devil's Face" Version 1.6.3
notes.notes:
Immerse Yourself in Enhanced Terror: "The Devil's Face" Version 1.6.3

Prepare to face the chilling depths of horror with the release of "The Devil's Face" version 1.6.3, featuring a host of enhancements that will elevate your gameplay experience and immerse you deeper into the game's spine-tingling atmosphere.

Key Updates:

Refined Gameplay: Experience smoother controls, enhanced responsiveness, and intuitive mechanics that will amplify your engagement and adrenaline rush as you navigate the game's terrifying world.

Enhanced Visuals: Delve into a world transformed with improved visual effects, bringing the chilling atmosphere to life with greater detail and realism. Prepare to be mesmerized by the haunting beauty of this terrifying realm.

Elevated Soundscapes: Immerse your senses in a world of heightened auditory immersion. Improved sound quality will make every sound effect and ambient noise send shivers down your spine, making the game's terrifying moments even more visceral.

Embark on an Unforgettable Journey:

With these enhancements, "The Devil's Face" version 1.6.3 promises to deliver an even more immersive and terrifying experience. Brace yourself for startling encounters, navigate treacherous environments, and unravel the secrets that lie within the depths of darkness.

Stay Tuned for More Thrills:

We are committed to continuously improving "The Devil's Face" and providing our players with an unforgettable and terrifying experience. Stay tuned for upcoming updates that will introduce even more enhancements and terrifying content.

notes.title: Presenting the Exciting New Update for "The Devil's Face"!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce the release of version 1.6.2 of our game, "The Devil’s Face". The new version includes the following updates:

- Resolved bug affecting mouse sensitivity
- Corrected a bug in the display of the interaction icon
- Made the main menu background static
- Smoothed out sharp in-game sounds
- We added cloud saves support

Additionally, we've been working on a significant update based on your feedback over the past few months. This update is set to be released in early 2024. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Patch v1.5.1
notes.notes:
Patch v1.5.1 fixed the following issues:

- Language settings
    - Italian does not appear correctly after being selected
    - Romanian does not appear correctly after being selected

notes.title: Publication of Version 1.5.0 - The Devil’s Face
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce the publication of version 1.5.0 of our game, The Devil's Face! This major update includes four new languages: Italian, Polish, Portuguese, and Romanian. We have also made some minor improvements and bug fixes.

Please note that translations of languages other than English and Greek may not be perfect. However, we believe that an imperfect translation is better than no translation at all. It is important to keep in mind that in our game, the text plays a central role. This is why we provide our players with more translations to make our game accessible to more people.

notes.title: Publication of Version 1.4.1
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce the publication of version 1.4.1 of our game! The new version includes the following changes:

- Fixed the possibility of a death loop.
- Added a warning message if you don't have lighter fluid and the lighter has only 10% remaining life!
- Added a 5-second delay before dying because you don't have lighter fluid and your lighter is dead, so the player can understand the cause of dying.
- Made some minor audio and visual improvements.

Our game is already a full game, but we continue to develop it. We plan to add more game features and gameplay in future updates. Stay tuned for the next big and small updates!

notes.title: Release v.1.3.0
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release of version 1.3.0 of our game, The Devil's Face. We have completed the development cycle of our game based on the goals we set from the beginning and offer players all the game elements listed on our Steam game homepage.

Like any game, ours may still have some minor bugs, and we apologize if you find any. We would appreciate it if you let us know so we can fix them. However, by purchasing our game, you can expect to play a complete game without any major problems.

We would also like to note that our original plan was to release the game into early access for 1-2 months to make sure it was working properly. Unfortunately, the Steam Early Access philosophy is different. As a result, we published our game normally, but left the game version in beta for technical reasons.

Finally, we want you to know that your opinion of us is important, and we will carefully consider all your comments and observations. We will try to incorporate them into our game. Thank you for playing The Devil's Face.

notes.title: Latest update - The Devil’s Face
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the release of version 1.1.0 of our game, The Devil's Face, in closed beta, as well as the game's demo. The new version includes all nine languages: English, Greek, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Turkish. Additionally, we have been working hard to improve the game's performance.

[b]We can't wait to hear your feedback![/b]

The primary languages used in our game are English and Greek. The purpose of the other translations is to help foreign players understand the game, rather than to be perfect. [b]Please note[/b] that these translations may contain some issues.

notes.title: The closed beta for our game, The Devil's Face, is almost ready for release!
notes.notes: We're excited to announce that the closed beta for our game, The Devil's Face, is almost ready for release! This marks yet another goal achieved on time, following the release of the game's demo. The purpose of the closed beta tests is to identify and correct the final imperfections in the game, ensuring its commercial release is of the highest quality.

notes.title: The Devil’s Face Demo update
notes.notes:
Based on your valuable feedback, we have made some changes to our game's demo. Some of the most important changes are listed below:

- We resolved the issue with the FPS lock being set at 120 FPS.
- We corrected the hint for the base game movements in the starting scene of our game.
- We offer players more flexible gameplay. 
- In the room where most players get stuck, we have set a timer that unlocks the door if the player fails to find the trigger.

We really appreciate you playing our game and providing feedback!

notes.title: Release of The Devil's Face Game Demo
notes.notes: We are excited to announce the release of the demo for our game, The Devil's Face. After much hard work and incorporating numerous improvements and changes to the gameplay, we believe that the demo will provide players with a good and accurate representation of our game. We invite you to play the demo and share your thoughts and opinions with us!

notes.title: Release of Version Alpha 0.5.0
notes.notes: We are pleased to announce that version alpha 0.5.0 has been released to our testers. This new version introduces a new level to our gameplay and removes the tutorial, which we found to be impractical and not improving the overall game experience after conducting tests. Instead, the hint that players may need is now incorporated into the gameplay itself. We have also made visual and audio improvements, as well as upgraded our codebase. We extend our appreciation to our alpha testers for providing valuable feedback. We continue to work hard to meet our targets and timelines, so stay tuned for future updates.

notes.title: Update on The Devil's Face
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the completion of our latest update to our game, The Devil's Face. Our team has been hard at work, and we are proud to present version alpha 0.3.7. This update includes a host of new features that will enhance your gaming experience.

Firstly, we have added Greek translation to the game. Now players who speak Greek can enjoy the game in their native language. Additionally, we have included a mouse sensitivity option, which can be adjusted to your liking. This will allow for greater customization and control in your gameplay. Moreover, we have added an FPS locker option, which will improve the overall performance of the game.

Furthermore, we have completely revamped the sound control system of the game. You can now adjust the following sound options: Master volume, Music volume, SFX volume, and Ambient volume. This will enable you to have greater control over the sound effects and music in the game, allowing for a more immersive experience.

We have also taken the time to fix any bugs that were present in the previous version. Our team understands the importance of providing players with a seamless gaming experience, and we have taken steps to ensure that any issues have been resolved. In addition to bug fixes, we have also made improvements to the existing code base. This will lead to a more stable and reliable game.

However, our work is far from over. We are excited to begin implementing new game features, mechanics, and levels. Our team is dedicated to providing players with an enjoyable and engaging gaming experience, and we will continue to work tirelessly to achieve this goal. Stay tuned for our latest updates, and thank you for your continued support of The Devil's Face!
